text: {"assertions":["On 2026-05-03, an off-by-one error in a slice bound in services/auth/session_store.py caused request timeouts that only affected jobs scheduled across midnight boundaries.","The fix involved correcting the slice bound and adding a property test, submitted as PR #2085 on branch fix/request-timeout-1.","The bug was reproducible by sending two POST /login requests against a warm cache.","The test failure rate decreased from 10 per 100 runs to zero after the fix was applied.","A 30-second request deadline appearing in the gateway log was the symptom indicating the bug.","The test coverage for this fix is located in tests/auth/test_session_store.py."]}
